title: UI layer imports directly from db (forbidden boundary)
ruleExplanation: The UI layer must not import from the data-access (db) layer directly. UI should call domain operations; the domain (or an application service) coordinates persistence. Direct UI→db coupling bypasses business rules and makes the layers untestable independently.
expectedEndCondition: The violation 'ui-no-db' is absent from a same-config re-scan. All tests in the test commands still pass.
